categories.main_business_segments: Synagistics operates two main business segments: the D2B (Direct-to-Business/Brands) segment, which provides integrated, data-driven digital solutions to brands for all aspects of e-commerce, and the D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) segment, which involves selling brands’ products directly to consumers. The company has strategically shifted focus towards the higher-margin D2B segment, leveraging its proprietary Synagie Platform and digital solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is the proprietary Synagie Platform, a data-driven digital platform that collects, analyzes, and deploys large data sets to optimize e-commerce operations for brand partners. The platform integrates with major online marketplaces, supports advanced order and inventory management, and incorporates automation, AI, and machine learning to enhance operational efficiency and supply chain management. The business model is asset-light, relying on outsourced warehousing and logistics managed through digital systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are brand partners, including global and regional brands across sectors such as fashion and apparel, premium beauty and wellness, and premium lifestyle and living. The company serves both businesses (via D2B solutions) and end consumers (via D2C sales), with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of revenue, indicating a diversified client base.
categories.geographic_coverage: Synagistics has a strong presence in the six main economies of Southeast Asia: Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia. The company is also expanding its footprint into Hong Kong, Greater China, and Spain, with ongoing efforts to further internationalize its operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It acts as a digital enabler and integrator for brands, managing e-commerce operations, digital marketing, and fulfillment through third-party logistics partners, rather than owning physical supply chain assets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the D2B digital solutions business, investing in AI and machine learning for automation and data analytics, and pursuing strategic acquisitions and joint ventures to enhance technological capabilities and market reach. The company is focused on innovation in enterprise AI, digital transformation, and building a scalable, asset-light business model with a strong emphasis on sustainability and ESG solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through two primary streams: service fees and digital solution sales to brand partners under the D2B model, and product sales to consumers under the D2C model. The company is increasingly emphasizing recurring, higher-margin revenue from digital solutions and platform services, while reducing reliance on lower-margin product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include regional and global e-commerce enablers, digital solutions providers, and technology-driven supply chain integrators. Synagistics differentiates itself through its proprietary technology platform, asset-light model, and focus on AI-driven solutions, positioning itself as an innovation leader and a frontrunner in enterprise digital transformation in Southeast Asia and beyond.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, Synagistics reported revenue of SGD101.9 million, down 19.5% year-on-year due to the strategic shift towards D2B. Gross profit remained stable at SGD31.3 million with an improved margin of 30.8%. The company recorded a significant net loss of SGD269.8 million, mainly due to non-cash De-SPAC and share-based payment expenses, but adjusted EBITDA loss improved by 42% to SGD3.9 million. The company is on a trajectory towards profitability, with improving margins and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Synagistics offers a unique value proposition through its integrated, data-driven digital solutions platform, enabling brands to unify consumer experiences across digital touchpoints and optimize e-commerce operations. Its asset-light, scalable model, advanced AI and automation capabilities, and commitment to sustainability (including verified carbon neutrality) set it apart from competitors, providing brand partners with enhanced operational efficiency, actionable insights, and support for ESG objectives.
